integrity: Full proof and self-contained checker included; numerical diagnostics do not establish asymptotic claims.
scientific_limitations: Proved for two-by-two neutral Jordan B_c with 0<c<3/2, Hermitian positive-semidefinite H0<I; excludes c=0, boundary norm 2, larger matrices, uniform small-c asymptotics, and independent validation.
title: Rank-sensitive critical decay in a two-node nonnormal matrix logistic map
